a.lede: Google has detailed its new Googlebooks, five laptops combining Android and ChromeOS to make a Mac-like experience for Android users, with a ton of Gemini tacked on.
a.title: Hands-on with Googlebooks — Five models, the new Googlebook OS, and a Mac-style experience for Android users at premium prices

b.lede: There are a few things about using a Googlebook that immediately feel just right. The hardware is polished (since it's based on current laptops).
